panels.title: Current Work
panels.description: This tile shows what the worker does now, inside the phase that the Phase tile shows.

panels.title: Attempts

targets.expr: max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_attempts{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}) or (max by (namespace, name) (last_over_time(pgcopydb_migration_attempts{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}[$__range])) unless max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}))

panels.description: This tile shows the number of worker Jobs that the operator created for this Migration. After you delete the Migration, the tile shows its last value in the time range.

panels.title: Elapsed

targets.expr: max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_completion_time_seconds{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}) - max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_start_time_seconds{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}) or time() - max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_start_time_seconds{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}) or ((max by (namespace, name) (last_over_time(pgcopydb_migration_completion_time_seconds{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}[$__range])) - max by (namespace, name) (last_over_time(pgcopydb_migration_start_time_seconds{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}[$__range]))) unless max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"})) or max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"} * -1)

panels.description: This tile shows how long the run took. While the run continues, it shows the time since the start.

panels.title: Completed At

targets.expr: max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_completion_time_seconds{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}) * 1000 or (max by (namespace, name) (last_over_time(pgcopydb_migration_completion_time_seconds{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}[$__range])) * 1000 unless max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"})) or max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"} * 0)

panels.description: This tile shows when the run ended. It shows Still Running until then.

panels.title: ETA By Size

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, name) (clamp_min(pgcopydb_migration_source_database_size_bytes{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"} - pgcopydb_migration_target_database_size_bytes{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}, 0) / clamp_min(deriv(pgcopydb_migration_target_database_size_bytes{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}[$__rate_interval]), 1) / 60) and on (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_phase{namespace="$namespace", name="$name", phase="Cloning"} == 1) or sum by (namespace, name) (-1 * (pgcopydb_migration_phase{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"} == 1))

panels.description: This tile estimates the minutes until the target size reaches the source size, from the current growth rate of the target. It shows Calculating when it cannot estimate, and No ETA outside the Cloning phase.

panels.title: Tables (Source)
panels.description: This tile shows the number of source tables that also exist on the target, so a filtered migration counts only its own tables.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_tables_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}) or (max by (namespace, name) (last_over_time(pgcopydb_migration_tables_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}[$__range])) unless max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}))

panels.title: Tables (Target)
panels.description: This tile shows the number of tables that have rows on the target or no rows on the source. If a finished copy shows fewer tables than the source, a table with rows on the source has no rows on the target.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_tables_done{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}) or (max by (namespace, name) (last_over_time(pgcopydb_migration_tables_done{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}[$__range])) unless max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}))

panels.title: Indexes (Source)
panels.description: This tile shows the number of source indexes on the tables that the target has. It ignores excludeIndexes, so the value is too high when a migration uses that option.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_indexes_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}) or (max by (namespace, name) (last_over_time(pgcopydb_migration_indexes_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}[$__range])) unless max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}))

panels.title: Indexes (Target)
panels.description: This tile shows the number of indexes that exist on the target.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_indexes_done{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}) or (max by (namespace, name) (last_over_time(pgcopydb_migration_indexes_done{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}[$__range])) unless max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}))

panels.title: Bytes (Source)
panels.description: This tile shows the size of the table data on the source, with TOAST and without indexes. Bytes (Target) is often a little lower, as [Why does the target show fewer bytes than the source?](https://ydixken.github.io/pgcopydb-operator/operations/monitoring/#why-does-the-target-show-fewer-bytes-than-the-source) explains.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_clone_planned_bytes{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}) or (max by (namespace, name) (last_over_time(pgcopydb_migration_clone_planned_bytes{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}[$__range])) unless max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}))

panels.title: Bytes (Target)
panels.description: This tile shows the size of the table data on the target, or by default after the copy the bytes that pgcopydb sent. It is often a little lower than Bytes (Source) but can be higher, as [Why does the target show fewer bytes than the source?](https://ydixken.github.io/pgcopydb-operator/operations/monitoring/#why-does-the-target-show-fewer-bytes-than-the-source) explains.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_clone_copied_bytes{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}) or (max by (namespace, name) (last_over_time(pgcopydb_migration_clone_copied_bytes{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}[$__range])) unless max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}))

panels.title: Schema Verification
panels.description: This tile shows the result of pgcopydb compare schema for tables, columns, indexes, constraints and sequence values. It shows Deactivated when spec.verification.schema is false (the default) and no result exists.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_verification_check{namespace="$namespace", name="$name", check="schema"}) or (max by (namespace, name) (last_over_time(pgcopydb_migration_verification_check{namespace="$namespace", name="$name", check="schema"}[$__range])) unless max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"})) or max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"} * -2)

panels.title: Data Verification
panels.description: This tile shows whether the row counts and checksums of each table match, from pgcopydb compare data. It shows Deactivated when spec.verification.data is false (the default) and no result exists.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_verification_check{namespace="$namespace", name="$name", check="data"}) or (max by (namespace, name) (last_over_time(pgcopydb_migration_verification_check{namespace="$namespace", name="$name", check="data"}[$__range])) unless max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"})) or max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"} * -2)

panels.title: Phase Timeline
panels.description: This table shows when the dashboard first saw each phase in the time range. A phase shorter than one scrape does not appear here, but its condition appears in Condition Timeline.

panels.title: Condition Timeline
panels.description: This table shows when each condition last changed status, and it keeps the rows of a deleted Migration. A phase shorter than one scrape still shows here through its condition.

panels.title: Database Size
panels.description: This panel shows the size of the source and target databases, with indexes and catalogs. The values stop at the last sample when the worker pod ends.

panels.title: Copy Throughput
panels.description: This panel shows how fast the target database grows (Target Growth, never below 0) and how fast Bytes (Target) grows (Clone Copy). Clone Copy can jump up or down at the end, when pgcopydb's own count replaces the estimate.

panels.title: LSN Positions
panels.description: This panel shows the Source, Write, Replay and Endpos WAL positions as absolute byte values. It has data only in follow mode, and Endpos appears when a cutover sets it.

panels.title: WAL Generation
panels.description: This panel shows how fast the source writes WAL. The target must replay WAL at this rate to stay current.

panels.title: Cutover Drain

targets.expr: (max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_endpos_lsn_bytes{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}) - max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_replay_lsn_bytes{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"})) or ((max by (namespace, name) (last_over_time(pgcopydb_migration_endpos_lsn_bytes{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}[$__range])) - max by (namespace, name) (last_over_time(pgcopydb_migration_replay_lsn_bytes{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"}[$__range]))) unless max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"})) or max by (namespace, name) (pgcopydb_migration_info{namespace="$namespace", name="$name"} * -1)

panels.description: This tile shows the bytes that the target must still replay to reach the cutover endpos. Only the CutoverCompleted condition, not a value of 0, proves that the drain is complete.
